specification.outcome: A bounded campaign advances independent shared work without exceeding task, initiative, time, cost, token, or concurrency authority

scenarios.name: bounded deterministic scheduling
given: a campaign with finite bounds and ranked eligible tasks
when: the coordinator schedules another campaign step

scenarios.name: blocker deferral
given: pre-mutation and post-mutation blockers plus independent eligible work
then: pre-mutation work is released and deferred

scenarios.name: shutdown recovery
given: a campaign has recorded scheduling decisions
then: a restart-safe checkpoint preserves exact consumption and pending attention

acceptanceCriteria: Ad-hoc goals publish provenance-bearing Backlog tasks
Campaign decisions are durable before effect requests are exposed
specification.architectureImplications: Campaign scheduling is a deterministic functional core. The shell persists checkpoints and exposes only closed requests; workers cannot authorize effects.
